name: puppet-master
description: Seven composable Agent Skills for building, running, driving, inspecting, debugging, and profiling iOS apps on Simulator and device.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, drive, inspect, debug, and profile iOS apps
interface.longDescription: Seven composable skills that give an agent a closed observe-act-verify loop over iOS: command-line build, signing and verified launch, Simulator UI automation, native view hierarchy evidence, LLDB code-state root-cause analysis, memory graph analysis, test execution, and Instruments performance measurement. Every skill reports bounded evidence and distinguishes observation from inference.
defaultPrompt: Build my app and confirm it actually runs on the Simulator.
Drive the iOS Simulator and verify the checkout flow works.
Explain why this button is untappable on the current screen.
Measure cold launch time and compare it against the baseline.
